2026-11-01.title: The Lord Remembers
2026-11-01.verse: He gives food to his faithful followers; he always remembers his covenant.
2026-11-01.observation: I don’t always have the best memory. I can remember some things, but others are gone as quickly as they cross my mind. I have a daughter that is not like that at all. She can remember things so clearly. But even she needs something to start the memory. If you give her a place or a circumstance, she can usually pull up the rest. Isn’t it great that God is even better than that?! He doesn’t have to be reminded about His promises or told that He said He would take care of us. Even before we have a problem, God has already planned the next step. Therefore, truly believing this in our hearts can bring us great joy. We realize that God is always ahead of all our issues and He remembers His faithfulness toward us.
2026-11-01.application: Rest in the promise that God will never forget you.
2026-11-01.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for always being so very faithful toward us.

2026-11-02.title: One of the Hardest Tools of Discipleship
2026-11-02.verse: It goes well for the one who generously lends money and conducts his business honestly.
2026-11-02.observation: It is generally not difficult to be inspired to know God more. It is generally not difficult to grow in freedom by doing life with others and letting our lives be a witness. It is not too difficult to give of ourselves to others and serve as Jesus Christ served others. However, one of the most difficult things to do is to be generous with our money. It is such a difficult concept that is so often pushed against that modern day pastors have started using other phrases like our “resource,” our “provision,” or our “gifts” as a way to approach the topic. There are many reasons for this but one of the reasons is because nothing fights for our hearts quite like our finances. We try to get from our money what only God can provide. As a child of God, our significance, security, and acceptance come from Him. However, we try to use money to buy things we don’t want to impress people we don’t like so they will give us what only God can give. So, take a moment and think about it. The best way to know the condition of your heart is your willingness to give it away without any visible return. Would you give to someone if they never knew? Would you be faithful to give to God’s church if no one noticed?
2026-11-02.application: Do you faithfully give to your local church? Honestly examine your heart and think about why or why not.
2026-11-02.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for growing us in the hard areas.

2026-11-03.title: Everyone Has A Place In God’s Family
2026-11-03.verse: He makes the barren woman of the family a happy mother of children. Praise the Lord.
2026-11-03.observation: I have always dreamed of pastoring a church that was not predominantly young or old, white or black, male or female. I have always dreamed of pastoring a church that looked like Heaven. This also goes for those who do not have an upbringing or a current situation that mirrors everyone else. This can be difficult because it is hard-wired into us all to go into every room looking for people like us. It gives us a sense of calm and that we are not alone. In the Kingdom of God, we have the opportunity to create environments like this. The doorway is salvation. Once we establish Jesus as our King, we can begin to grow from there. Our rallying point can be something greater than our melanin, background, or cultural status. It can be that we are all saved by the grace of God. When we do this, everyone can find their place in God’s family.
2026-11-03.application: How are you making room for people different than you in God’s House?
2026-11-03.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for always making room for us.

2026-11-04.title: A Continual Reminder
2026-11-04.verse: who turned a rock into a pool of water, a hard rock into springs of water.
2026-11-04.observation: In many of the songs in the Bible, we find a consistent reminder of when God brought the nation of Israel water in the desert. Moses hit a rock and enough water flowed out to take care of all the needs for an entire nation! It’s no wonder they consistently remember this and continue to point to this moment as a sign that God will always make a way. Do you have a time in your life when God did something amazing? I do. I can remember a time when I desperately needed a job and it had to be for a certain amount of money or I could not support my family. In one meeting, the Lord not only made a way for me to get a job but it was within my skillset, the hours were exactly what I needed, and the money was what I needed! I know the Lord did it because the guy said he had been praying and felt what he offered was what the Lord had put on his heart. I consistently think back on this when all feels lost and I don’t know how the Lord will work it out. If He can bring water from a rock, He is able. If He can bring a job that fits exactly what I needed in a moment of desperation, He is able. God is able in your life, too.
2026-11-04.application: Find a moment in your life when God did something awesome. Hold on to it and point to it as a sign of God’s faithfulness.
2026-11-04.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for doing the impossible in our lives.

2026-11-05.title: You Become Who You Hang Around
2026-11-05.verse: Those who make them will end up like them, as will everyone who trusts in them. O Israel, trust in the Lord. He is their deliverer and protector. O family of Aaron, trust in the Lord. He is their deliverer and protector.
2026-11-05.observation: Today’s song talks about how those who worship these dead and worthless idols become just like them. Worshiping a dead god only makes you dead on the inside. However, we should put our trust in the Lord because He is far from dead. He is alive and active in our world and in our lives. Therefore, we should spend time in His presence, in worship, in reading His Word, and in reflection about His goodness. People have a tendency to begin imitating what we spend time around. It’s part of our nature. If we hang around the dead things of the world, we will begin acting in that way. But, if we spend time with the Lord and reading about His character in His Word, we will begin reflecting His nature and character as well.
2026-11-05.application: Spend time reflecting on the Lord today and never see that as wasted time. You are slowly learning how to become more like Christ.
2026-11-05.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for always welcoming us into Your presence.

2026-11-06.title: Slaves to Servants to Sons
2026-11-06.verse: Yes, Lord! I am indeed your servant; I am your servant, the son of your female servant. You saved me from death.
2026-11-06.observation: Today’s song reminded me of a statement made by a fictional character called Screwtape. *The Screwtape Letters* is a fictional book by C.S. Lewis to discuss how spiritual warfare works itself out in the daily life of a Christian. In this creative narrative, Screwtape is a senior demon writing correspondence back and forth to a junior apprentice. In one such letter he says that the devil’s job is to trick people into thinking they are servants but he really creates slaves. However, God takes slaves, makes them servants so they can become sons. It’s a powerful idea of how the process of discipleship happens in our lives. When we begin to follow Jesus, we do so as a servant and following what His Word says because we want to serve the Lord. As we continue to follow, we begin to slowly understand the reasoning why and it goes from worshipful obligation to understanding cooperation. God’s goal is nothing less than our complete freedom.
2026-11-06.application: Think about why God’s Word tells us to do and not to do some things. It is for our benefit. Do we trust God enough to obey until we understand?
2026-11-06.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for leading us more and more each day.

2026-11-07.title: The Power of Love
2026-11-07.verse: For his loyal love towers over us, and the Lord’s faithfulness endures. Praise the Lord.
2026-11-07.observation: Today’s song is the shortest in the book of Psalms. In my imagination, I have wondered if this was one of those songs that repeated these lyrics over and over again accompanied by a lot of musical solos. Either way, this song has a powerful point. It says God’s love for us is powerful. Have you ever thought about that? There are many things we have a passing care about. We say we love certain foods. We say we love sports teams. We say we love seasons of the year. However, there are some things or people that we love so much that our love for them compels us to action. We truly love our family. We truly love our closest friends. God’s love for us is not a passive love that fades away with the season. His love is so strong that He was willing to come to Earth, die on our Cross, and rise again so we can have life. That is a powerful force. That same love that kept Him on the Cross is the same love He has for you right now. You have never been more loved than you are right now.
2026-11-07.application: Think about how much the Lord loves you.
2026-11-07.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for loving us even when we do not always love ourselves.

2026-11-08.title: Every Day is God’s Day
2026-11-08.verse: This is the Lord’s work. We consider it amazing! This is the day the Lord has brought about. We will be happy and rejoice in it.
2026-11-08.observation: I heard a guy once say that he divided his week up into three sections: his boss’s days, his family’s day, and the Lord’s day. He worked five days a week and said those days belonged to his company. He gave his greatest strength to those days so he could provide for his family. Not only that, but he still saw his family in the evenings and spent quality time with them. Likewise, he just knew that those days were primary for earning. Then, he had one day off from work, and he gave that to his family. He reserved open time to pursue interests with them. Then, every Sunday he called the Lord’s day. Here was the catch: he said that those were only available to him because they were all truly the Lord’s days. He was given strength to work, a family to bless, and a church to worship. He saw it all as gifts from the Lord. How blessed would we be if we truly realized that, while we say one day is for this or that person, all days are truly from the Lord. Therefore, we can rejoice in every day.
2026-11-08.application: Start your day with thankfulness to the Lord and watch how the rest of the week goes.
2026-11-08.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for all Your many blessings every single day.

2026-11-09.title: If We Could Only See
2026-11-09.verse: Open my eyes so I can truly see the marvelous things in your law.
2026-11-09.observation: As a pastor, I think one of my biggest tasks is to get people to read their Bibles. Almost anything people say they want or need in life ultimately comes back, in part, to whether or not they are getting to know God more through reading His Word. God’s Word is where He reveals Himself to us. God’s Word is where He shows us the way. His Word gives us insight for life, and tells us the wonderful truth of salvation. However, there is always a massive hindrance to reading God’s Word and I think that is by design. Some of the greatest spiritual warfare will come as we determine to read God’s Word. We have a spiritual enemy who does not want us to read God’s Word. But, if we could only see how wonderful God’s Word truly is, we would be hungry to know God’s Word more. Every time we read God’s Word, it is like the voice of God whispering fresh wind over our souls.
2026-11-09.application: Make a plan to read God’s Word slowly every day. Let the truth of God slowly pour over your soul.
2026-11-09.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for speaking to us through Your Word.

2026-11-10.title: Take Your Burdens to the Lord
2026-11-10.verse: A song of ascents. In my distress I cried out to the Lord and he answered me.
2026-11-10.observation: Today’s song gives us a great reminder that we do not have to carry our burdens alone. I love an old song that used to say, “Take your burdens to the Lord and leave it there.” The second half of that phrase is important. Many times, we will take our burdens to the Lord and then take the responsibility of them with us back out of the room. I’m not saying we do not still have to deal with the issue. We cannot give up on our responsibilities. However, we do not have to carry the weight of fixing it. We do our best and trust that the Lord is doing all that we cannot see.
2026-11-10.application: Today, take your burdens to the Lord and leave it there.
2026-11-10.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for always being willing to walk with us through every season of life.

2026-11-11.title: Where Do You Go When It Matters?
2026-11-11.verse: A song of ascents. I look up toward the hills. From where does my help come? My help comes from the Lord, the Creator of heaven and earth. May he not allow your foot to slip. May your Protector not sleep.
2026-11-11.observation: When my girls were little, they both went through a season where they wanted to do everything themselves. They didn’t want any help. One of my daughters would get so angry if we tried to do anything for her and yell out, “Me do it. Me do it.” She was determined to be self-sufficient. My wife and I had to struggle not to laugh at this little girl who was completely reliant on us yet thought she was completely independent. Also, all the independence would melt away as soon as she would get hurt. I often wonder if God looks at us like that. We live in His world, breathe His air, and experience His goodness all around us. Yet, we try to act like we can do anything independently of Him. What matters even more is what happens when something goes wrong. Where do we truly turn? God invites us to look to Him. He will hold us up. He will help us walk through any dark valley. He is already with us more than we realize.
2026-11-11.application: Get God involved before you have to. He’s already there.
2026-11-11.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for walking with us and having more kindness than we can imagine.

2026-11-12.title: The Joy of Community Worship
2026-11-12.verse:
I was glad because they said to me,  
'We will go to the Lord’s temple.'
2026-11-12.observation: We live in a culture where we can do almost anything online. This possibility has made many things better. I'll admit that I would rather shop online. I would rather order food online. I would rather do research online than go to a library. However, some things cannot be replicated. One of these is the timeless joy of worshiping God in a spiritual community. The church is intended to be an outpost of Heaven in the world. We are people who have been radically changed by the mercy of Jesus. When we gather, we become a glimpse of Heaven. Our primary goal is to worship the Lord together. This cannot be replicated online. Therefore, one of the greatest joys in our lives should be to gather together and worship the Lord. Because of this, the enemy will do everything to destroy our church communities. We have to fight for unity, fight for forgiveness, and fight to stay together every day. We can only do this if we do it together.
2026-11-12.application: Make consistent community worship with your spiritual family a priority.
2026-11-12.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for the opportunity to do life with other people on the same journey toward spiritual maturity.

2026-11-13.title: The Honor of the King's Help
2026-11-13.verse: I look up toward you, the one enthroned in heaven.
2026-11-13.observation: There is an old phrase: familiarity breeds contempt. This means that what we experience regularly, we begin to take for granted. Because of this, marketing companies intentionally make products available only at certain times of the year. There was a time when you could only get certain lattes around the holiday season. It was not because there was a shortage. They were trying to create demand by creating a shortage in supply. While this can be a good marketing strategy, it also shows a problem many Christians have. Because God is always close, we can begin to take Him for granted. We can begin to think of God as common, or only a little better than us. The reality is that we are extremely blessed to be able to look up to God and receive His blessings. He is a great King, and maybe the greatest thing is that He is also good. So, the next time you pray and talk to Him, think about the fact that you have more access to the King of the Universe than you do to your local political leader. You are blessed beyond measure.
2026-11-13.application: Take a moment and think about how great the Lord is, and how He shows it through His goodness.
2026-11-13.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for the honor of being able to talk to You so freely.
